quick_ratio.formula: (Cash and Cash Equivalents + Marketable Debt Securities + Accounts and Notes Receivable, net + Current GM Financial Receivables) / (Short-term Debt and Current Portion of Long-term Debt (Automotive) + Accounts Payable + Current GM Financial Liabilities + Accrued Liabilities)
